question.en: What is Total Float, and how is it calculated?
question.ar: ما هو الـ Total Float، وكيف يتم حسابه؟

model_answer.en: Total Float is the amount of time an activity can be delayed from its early dates without delaying the project completion date or violating a schedule constraint (such as a Must Finish By date). It is calculated from the forward and backward passes: Total Float = Late Finish − Early Finish (or Late Start − Early Start). In P6 the project setting decides whether Total Float is computed as start float, finish float, or the smallest of the two. Total Float is a property of the path, not only of the single activity: activities on the same path share it.
model_answer.ar_explanation: الـ Total Float هو المدة التي يمكن أن يتأخر فيها النشاط عن تواريخه المبكرة (Early Dates) دون أن يتأخر تاريخ انتهاء المشروع أو يُخالَف Constraint. يُحسب من الـ Forward Pass والـ Backward Pass: LF − EF. والنقطة المهمة: الـ Float مِلك للمسار (Path) وليس للنشاط وحده، يعني لو نشاط استهلكه، الأنشطة التالية على نفس المسار تفقده.

required_points.text: Delay allowed without delaying project completion (or a constraint)
LF − EF or LS − ES

advanced_points.text: Float is shared along the path, consuming it affects successors' float
P6 setting: start float / finish float / smallest
Float is measured against the project must-finish date or constraints, not only the 'project end'

red_flags.text: Defines Total Float as delay without delaying the immediate successor (that is Free Float)

question.en: Who owns the float, the activity or the path?
question.ar: مين صاحب الـ Float: النشاط ولا المسار؟

expects: Float is shared along the path
Consuming it reduces float of downstream activities

question.en: If the project has a Must Finish By date earlier than the calculated finish, what happens to Total Float?
question.ar: لو المشروع له Must Finish By أبكر من تاريخ الانتهاء المحسوب، ماذا يحدث للـ Total Float؟

expects: Late dates calculated from the imposed date
Total Float becomes negative on driving activities

misconceptions: Total Float and Free Float are the same thing
Float belongs to the individual activity

question.en: Can an activity have Total Float = 10 days but Free Float = 0? Explain how.
question.ar: هل يمكن أن يكون لنشاط Total Float = 10 أيام و Free Float = صفر؟ اشرح كيف.

model_answer.en: Yes. Free Float is the delay possible without delaying the early start of any immediate successor; Total Float is the delay possible without delaying project completion. If the activity is immediately followed by a successor that starts as soon as it finishes, any delay pushes the successor's early start (Free Float = 0). But if that successor and the remainder of the path have 10 days of slack before they affect the project finish, the activity still has 10 days of Total Float. The float belongs to the path and sits at the end of it. Practical consequence: delaying this activity by 5 days will not delay the project but will consume 5 days of float from its successors.
model_answer.ar_explanation: نعم. الـ Free Float يقيس التأخير المسموح بدون تأخير الـ Early Start لأي Successor مباشر، والـ Total Float يقيس التأخير المسموح بدون تأخير المشروع. لو النشاط بعده مباشرة Successor يبدأ فور انتهائه، Free Float = 0. لكن لو المسار كله فيه 10 أيام Slack قبل نهاية المشروع، يبقى Total Float = 10. الأثر العملي: تأخير النشاط 5 أيام لا يؤخر المشروع لكنه يأكل 5 أيام من Float الأنشطة التالية.

required_points.text: Yes, it is possible
Free Float relates to immediate successor early start
Total Float relates to project completion
Successor starts immediately but the path has slack downstream

acceptable_points.text: Gives a numeric or network example

advanced_points.text: Delay consumes successors' float, so it is not 'free'
Free Float is always ≤ Total Float (for unconstrained activities)

red_flags.text: Says delaying it by 10 days has no impact on anything

question.en: The activity is delayed 5 days. What happens to the successor and the project?
question.ar: النشاط تأخر 5 أيام. ماذا يحدث للـ Successor وللمشروع؟

expects: Successor early start moves 5 days
Project finish unchanged
Path Total Float reduces to 5

question.en: And if it is delayed 15 days?
question.ar: ولو تأخر 15 يومًا؟

expects: Project finish delayed 5 days
Path becomes critical with −5 days float if a must-finish date exists

what_if_variations.en: Activity has TF = 10, FF = 4. It is delayed 6 days.
what_if_variations.ar: نشاط TF = 10 و FF = 4، تأخر 6 أيام.

misconceptions: Zero Free Float means the activity is critical

scenario.en: During the monthly update the project completion moved 20 days beyond the contractual completion date (Project Must Finish By). Project Total Float is now −20 days. Activity A1050 (MEP first fix, Level 3) shows −45 days Total Float. The Project Manager asks: "Does this mean A1050 is causing the entire project delay?"
scenario.ar: في التحديث الشهري تحرك تاريخ انتهاء المشروع 20 يومًا بعد التاريخ التعاقدي (Project Must Finish By). الـ Project Total Float أصبح −20 يومًا. النشاط A1050 (أعمال MEP First Fix بالدور الثالث) يظهر عليه −45 يومًا. مدير المشروع يسألك: «هل ده معناه إن A1050 هو سبب تأخير المشروع كله؟»

question.en: How would you respond, and what would you check to explain why A1050 is more negative than the project?
question.ar: كيف سترد، وما الذي ستفحصه لتفسير لماذا A1050 سالب أكثر من المشروع؟

model_answer.en: Not necessarily. The project finish is only 20 days late, so the path driving the completion date is at −20. A1050 being at −45 means something other than the project finish is setting its late dates. Most likely: (1) a constraint on A1050 or on one of its successors (e.g., a Finish On or Before on an intermediate milestone such as 'Level 3 handover' or 'Power-on') that is earlier than achievable; (2) a successor milestone with an access/handover date; (3) external relationships to another project with earlier dates; (4) calendar effects, since float is displayed in the activity's own calendar units, so different calendars can distort comparison; (5) the float calculation setting (finish/start/smallest). I would: trace A1050's successors (Trace Logic) to find which successor or constraint sets its late finish; list all constraints in the project; run the Longest Path filter to see whether A1050 is on the path driving completion at all; check calendars and the external dates; and compare against last update to see what changed. Then I'd answer the PM: 'A1050 is behind an intermediate commitment by 45 days; the overall completion is driven by path X at −20 days. Recovering A1050 protects the milestone, recovering path X protects completion.'
model_answer.ar_explanation: مش بالضرورة. المشروع متأخر 20 يومًا فقط، إذن المسار الذي يقود تاريخ الانتهاء عند −20. لو A1050 عند −45 فهذا معناه أن شيئًا آخر غير نهاية المشروع هو اللي بيحدد الـ Late Dates بتاعته: غالبًا Constraint على النشاط أو على Successor (مثل Milestone وسيط بتاريخ تسليم)، أو علاقة خارجية بمشروع آخر، أو اختلاف الـ Calendars، أو إعداد حساب الـ Float. الفحص: Trace Logic للـ Successors، قائمة كل الـ Constraints، فلتر Longest Path، مقارنة بالتحديث السابق. الرد على المدير: النشاط متأخر عن التزام وسيط، أما نهاية المشروع فيقودها مسار آخر.

required_points.text: Does not accept that A1050 drives the whole delay without verification
Identifies a constraint/intermediate milestone on A1050 or its successors as a likely cause
Traces successors / driving logic to find what sets A1050's late dates
Checks whether A1050 is on the longest/driving path to completion

acceptable_points.text: Compares with previous update to see what changed

advanced_points.text: Float shown in activity calendar units; different calendars distort comparison
External relationships / other projects' dates
P6 Total Float calculation setting (start/finish/smallest)
Gives the PM a clear message separating milestone risk from completion risk

red_flags.text: Says yes, A1050 is causing the project delay because it is the most negative
Proposes deleting the constraint to 'fix' the float without checking it is contractual

question.en: What would you check first, and why that first?
question.ar: ما أول شيء ستفحصه، ولماذا هو أولاً؟

expects: Constraints / successors of A1050
Justification: the gap of 25 days must come from a nearer target than project finish

question.en: You found a Finish On or Before constraint on the 'Level 3 Handover' milestone. The site team says it's an old target and wants it deleted. Do you delete it?
question.ar: وجدت Finish On or Before على Milestone «تسليم الدور الثالث». فريق الموقع يقول إنه هدف قديم ويريد حذفه. هل تحذفه؟

expects: Check whether it is a contractual/sectional completion date
Do not delete contractual milestones to hide delay
If not contractual, document and agree before removing

question.en: What if A1050 is not on the longest path at all?
question.ar: ماذا لو A1050 ليس على الـ Longest Path أصلاً؟

expects: It still matters for the intermediate commitment
Recovery priority for completion is the longest path
It may become driving if it slips further

misconceptions: The most negative activity drives the project
Negative float always means the activity itself is late

scenario.en: You use a Global Change after each update to make Actual Cost equal Earned Value on resource-loaded activities (a common simplification when real costs are not tracked in P6). After this month's update, the EV report still shows AC ≠ EV for many activities.
scenario.ar: تستخدم Global Change بعد كل تحديث لجعل الـ Actual Cost مساويًا للـ Earned Value للأنشطة المحمّلة بموارد (تبسيط شائع عندما لا تُتابَع التكاليف الفعلية داخل P6). بعد تحديث هذا الشهر، تقرير الـ EV ما زال يظهر AC ≠ EV في أنشطة كثيرة.

question.en: Diagnose the possible reasons and describe how you would verify each.
question.ar: شخّص الأسباب المحتملة واشرح كيف ستتحقق من كل سبب.

model_answer.en: Possible reasons, roughly in the order I would check: (1) The Global Change 'If' conditions did not select those activities (filter by WBS/type/status excluded them) — check by running the change in preview and reviewing the change report. (2) The wrong field was targeted: activity-level Actual Total Cost is a summed/calculated value; actual cost lives on resource assignments (Actual Labor/Nonlabor/Material Cost) and project expenses, so the change must write to editable assignment fields. (3) Activities without resource assignments or expenses have no budget, so EV is zero or not comparable. (4) Project calculation settings recalculate actuals after the change — e.g., 'Recalculate actual units and cost when duration % complete changes' or 'Link Actual to Date and Actual This Period' overwrote values when progress was applied after the Global Change; order of operations matters. (5) EV is calculated differently than assumed: the Earned Value technique (Activity % Complete, 0/100, 50/50, WBS milestones) and the activity Percent Complete Type (duration/physical/units) drive EV, so the 'EV' value targeted in the formula may not be the one the report shows. (6) Report timing: values compared at a different data date or before summarizing/scheduling. I would verify on two or three sample activities: open the assignment, compare budget, actual and remaining cost before and after the change, then fix the root cause and re-run.
model_answer.ar_explanation: الأسباب المحتملة بترتيب الفحص: (1) شروط الـ Global Change لم تختر هذه الأنشطة. (2) استهداف حقل غلط — الـ Actual Total Cost على مستوى النشاط محسوب، والتكلفة الفعلية الحقيقية تكون على الـ Resource Assignments والـ Expenses. (3) أنشطة بدون Resources = بدون Budget، فالـ EV صفر. (4) إعدادات الحساب في المشروع (مثل Recalculate actual units and cost when duration % complete changes) أعادت الحساب بعد التغيير — ترتيب الخطوات مهم. (5) طريقة حساب الـ EV (EV Technique و Percent Complete Type) مختلفة عن المتوقع. (6) توقيت التقرير. والتحقق يكون على 2–3 أنشطة عينة قبل وبعد التغيير.

required_points.text: Global Change conditions did not select the activities
Actual cost sits on resource assignments/expenses; activity total is calculated
Project calculation settings / update order overwrite the values
Verifies on sample activities rather than guessing

advanced_points.text: EV technique and Percent Complete Type determine EV
Notes that forcing AC = EV hides real cost performance (CPI always 1.0)

red_flags.text: Concludes it is a P6 bug without investigation
Suggests typing values manually into the report/export

question.en: If AC is forced to equal EV every month, what does CPI tell management?
question.ar: لو الـ AC مُجبَر يساوي الـ EV كل شهر، ماذا يخبر الـ CPI الإدارة؟

expects: CPI = 1.0 always, it carries no information
Cost performance must be measured from real cost data elsewhere

question.en: The Global Change worked yesterday, but after you applied progress today the values changed again. Why?
question.ar: الـ Global Change اشتغل امبارح، لكن بعد إدخال الـ Progress النهارده القيم اتغيرت تاني. ليه؟

expects: Calculation settings recalculate actual cost from % complete/units
Sequence: progress → schedule → global change → verify

misconceptions: Activity-level cost fields can be edited directly
EV in P6 is always duration % × budget

scenario.en: Month 8 status of a building project: BAC = 40M SAR, PV = 10M, EV = 8M, AC = 9M. The contractor requests approval to add two more concrete crews to recover the schedule.
scenario.ar: حالة مشروع مبنى في الشهر الثامن: BAC = 40 مليون ريال، PV = 10M، EV = 8M، AC = 9M. المقاول يطلب الموافقة على إضافة طاقمين خرسانة لاستعادة البرنامج.

question.en: Calculate CV, SV, CPI, SPI and a CPI-based EAC. Interpret the results. Would you approve the extra crews immediately?
question.ar: احسب CV و SV و CPI و SPI و EAC على أساس الـ CPI. فسّر النتائج. هل توافق على الأطقم الإضافية فورًا؟

model_answer.en: CV = EV − AC = −1M (over budget). SV = EV − PV = −2M (behind in earned value). CPI = 8/9 = 0.89: for every 1 SAR spent, 0.89 SAR of work is earned. SPI = 8/10 = 0.80: 80% of planned value has been earned. EAC = BAC / CPI = 40 / 0.889 ≈ 45M, i.e., a forecast overrun of about 5M if current cost efficiency continues. Interpretation: the project is both behind and over budget. I would not approve immediately: (1) SPI is a value measure — it does not tell me whether the critical path is delayed; I need the schedule (critical path, float, forecast finish). (2) Adding crews at CPI 0.89 will likely worsen cost — I need the cause of low productivity (access, design, materials, supervision) because if it is not manpower, crews will not help. (3) Check workface constraints: formwork quantity, pump/crane capacity, concrete supply, site congestion. (4) Check entitlement: whose delay is it — this decides who pays. I would request a recovery programme showing which critical activities gain, by how many days, and at what cost.
model_answer.ar_explanation: CV = −1M (تجاوز تكلفة)، SV = −2M، CPI = 0.89، SPI = 0.80، EAC ≈ 45M. المشروع متأخر ومتجاوز للميزانية. لن أوافق فورًا لأن: الـ SPI مقياس قيمة ولا يوضح هل المسار الحرج متأخر؛ إضافة أطقم مع CPI منخفض غالبًا تزيد التكلفة؛ لازم أعرف سبب ضعف الإنتاجية؛ لازم أفحص قيود الموقع (شدات، مضخة، كرين، توريد خرسانة)؛ ولازم أعرف مسؤولية التأخير. أطلب Recovery Programme يوضح المكسب بالأيام والتكلفة.

required_points.text: CV −1M, SV −2M, CPI 0.89, SPI 0.80
EAC ≈ 45M
Behind schedule and over budget, correctly interpreted
Does not approve without more information

acceptable_points.text: Asks for cause of low productivity

advanced_points.text: SPI does not reflect critical path delay
Physical constraints may limit benefit of extra crews
Responsibility/entitlement decides who bears acceleration cost

question.en: SPI is 0.80 but the critical path shows zero delay. How is that possible?
question.ar: الـ SPI = 0.80 لكن المسار الحرج لا يظهر أي تأخير. كيف يحدث ذلك؟

expects: Lag in non-critical high-value activities
SPI measures value, not time on the critical path

question.en: Recalculate if AC = 7M instead. What changes in your recommendation?
question.ar: أعد الحساب لو AC = 7M. ماذا يتغير في توصيتك؟

expects: CPI = 1.14, under budget
Problem is schedule only; acceleration more affordable but still needs CP analysis

misconceptions: SPI < 1 always means the project will finish late

scenario.en: A critical activity has an Original Duration of 12 days on a 6-day workweek calendar (8 h/day). You change its calendar to a 5-day workweek calendar (also 8 h/day).
scenario.ar: نشاط حرج مدته الأصلية 12 يومًا على Calendar ستة أيام عمل أسبوعيًا (8 ساعات/يوم). غيّرت الـ Calendar إلى خمسة أيام عمل أسبوعيًا (8 ساعات/يوم أيضًا).

question.en: What happens to its duration, its finish date, its Total Float, and potentially the critical path?
question.ar: ماذا يحدث لمدته، وتاريخ انتهائه، والـ Total Float، وربما المسار الحرج؟

model_answer.en: Duration stays 12 working days (P6 stores duration in hours: 96 h; with the same 8 h/day it still displays 12 d). But 12 working days now spans more calendar time: about 2 weeks + 2 days elapsed instead of 2 weeks, so the finish date moves later (≈ 2 calendar days, depending on the start day and holidays). Because the activity is critical, its successors and the project finish move later by the same amount unless downstream float absorbs it, and Total Float on that path decreases (or becomes more negative against a must-finish date). The critical path may change: if a parallel path previously had little float, it may stop being critical relative to this path, or this path may become the sole longest path. Caveat: if the new calendar had different hours per day, the displayed duration in days would change (e.g., 96 h on a 10 h/day calendar shows 9.6 d) — a common source of confusion.
model_answer.ar_explanation: المدة تبقى 12 يوم عمل (P6 يخزن المدة بالساعات: 96 ساعة). لكن 12 يوم عمل على Calendar خمسة أيام تستغرق وقتًا تقويميًا أطول، فيتأخر تاريخ الانتهاء (تقريبًا يومين تقويميين حسب يوم البدء والعطلات). ولأن النشاط حرج، يتأخر المشروع بنفس القدر ويقل الـ Total Float. وممكن المسار الحرج يتغير. تنبيه: لو عدد ساعات اليوم مختلف في الـ Calendar الجديد، المدة المعروضة بالأيام هتتغير (96 ساعة على 10 ساعات/يوم = 9.6 يوم).

required_points.text: Working duration stays 12 days
Finish date moves later (more elapsed time)
Project finish / float on the path affected because it is critical

advanced_points.text: P6 stores durations in hours; hours/day change alters displayed days
Holiday/exception differences between calendars

red_flags.text: Says nothing changes because duration is unchanged

question.en: What if the activity had 15 days of Total Float instead of being critical?
question.ar: ماذا لو كان للنشاط 15 يوم Total Float بدل أن يكون حرجًا؟

expects: Finish moves later but float absorbs it
Project finish unchanged
Path float reduces

question.en: What if the successor uses a 7-day calendar? Where is float shown, and could it look inconsistent?
question.ar: ماذا لو الـ Successor على Calendar سبعة أيام؟ هل ممكن الـ Float يبان غير متسق؟

expects: Float displayed per activity calendar
Mixed calendars make float values along a path differ

misconceptions: Changing the calendar changes the number of working days
Calendars only affect the activity itself

scenario.en: For the same cut-off date: the contractor's monthly report claims 90% progress on the structural package, P6 (updated by your team) shows 75%, and the site engineer's quantity report gives 82%. The client wants one number for the monthly report by tomorrow.
scenario.ar: لنفس تاريخ القطع: تقرير المقاول الشهري يقول 90% في حزمة الإنشائي، P6 (المحدث بواسطة فريقك) يظهر 75%، وتقرير الكميات من مهندس الموقع يعطي 82%. العميل يريد رقمًا واحدًا للتقرير الشهري غدًا.

question.en: What do you do, and which number do you report?
question.ar: ماذا تفعل، وأي رقم ستضعه في التقرير؟

model_answer.en: Three different numbers usually mean three different measurement bases, not three opinions. I would reconcile: (1) Basis: is 90% by cost/payment value, 75% by P6 duration or physical %, 82% by quantities? (2) Weights: are the packages weighted by budget, man-hours or quantity, and are the weights the same? (3) Scope: does each include the same activities (e.g., contractor includes rebar delivered on site or formwork as progress)? (4) Cut-off: same data date? (5) Rules of credit: partial credit for incomplete elements (poured but not stripped/tested). Then verify the largest-variance items physically or with measured quantities. I would report one number based on the agreed measurement method in the contract/progress measurement procedure — typically the verified quantity-based, weighted physical progress — and show the reconciliation in a note: 'Contractor-claimed 90% (value incl. materials on site), verified physical 82%, P6 under-reported by 7% due to late update of X activities, corrected this period.' And I fix P6 so it reflects verified progress. I would not average the numbers or simply accept the contractor's figure.
model_answer.ar_explanation: ثلاثة أرقام مختلفة غالبًا تعني ثلاثة أسس قياس مختلفة. أوفّق بينهم: أساس القياس (تكلفة / مدة / كميات)، الأوزان، نطاق الأنشطة، تاريخ القطع، قواعد احتساب العمل غير المكتمل. ثم أتحقق فعليًا من البنود ذات أكبر فرق. أرفع رقمًا واحدًا حسب طريقة القياس المعتمدة في العقد/الإجراء (غالبًا Physical Progress موزون ومثبت بالكميات) مع ملاحظة توضح التوفيق، وأصحح P6. لا آخذ المتوسط ولا أقبل رقم المقاول كما هو.

required_points.text: Identifies different measurement bases
Verifies with quantities/site evidence
Reports according to the agreed/contractual measurement method
Discloses reconciliation transparently

advanced_points.text: Recognises materials-on-site / payment value inflates progress
Corrects the P6 update process, not only the number
Defines rules of credit for partially complete work

red_flags.text: Accepts the contractor's figure to avoid conflict
Reports one number with no explanation of the discrepancy

question.en: The contractor's PM calls you and says your 82% will damage their payment. What do you say?
question.ar: مدير مشروع المقاول اتصل وقال إن 82% ستضر بالدفعة. ماذا تقول له؟

expects: Payment and progress may use different bases
Offer joint measurement
Stay evidence-based

question.en: What if there is no progress measurement procedure in the contract?
question.ar: ماذا لو العقد لا يحتوي على إجراء لقياس التقدم؟

expects: Propose one and get it agreed
Document basis in the report until agreed

misconceptions: Progress is a single objective number regardless of method

scenario.en: Earlier in the interview you described a project where blockwork on Levels 3–6 finished four weeks late, and you said the cause was low productivity.
scenario.ar: في بداية المقابلة وصفت مشروعًا تأخرت فيه أعمال الطوب في الأدوار 3–6 أربعة أسابيع، وقلت إن السبب ضعف الإنتاجية.

question.en: You told me the blockwork delay was caused by low productivity. How did you prove that?
question.ar: قلت لي إن تأخير الطوب كان بسبب ضعف الإنتاجية. كيف أثبت ذلك؟

model_answer.en: I compared planned and achieved productivity using daily reports: planned 12 m²/man-day from the estimate; achieved 8 m²/man-day over 6 weeks, measured as installed quantity divided by man-days on the blockwork crews. Manpower on site matched the planned histogram, so it was not a manpower shortage, and there were no material stock-outs in the store records. Work fronts were available — the preceding activities were complete per the progress records — so it was not lack of access. Rework from the QA/QC NCR log was low. That left crew productivity itself, which we traced to an inexperienced subcontractor crew; productivity improved to 11 m²/man-day after the crew change, which supports the conclusion. If any of those checks had failed — no work front, no material, design changes — the cause would be disruption, not productivity, and responsibility could be different.
model_answer.ar_explanation: الإجابة القوية تُظهر الدليل: إنتاجية مخططة من التقدير مقابل الإنتاجية المحققة من التقارير اليومية (كمية منفذة ÷ أيام عمل العمال)، ثم استبعاد الأسباب الأخرى: العمالة كانت مطابقة للـ Histogram، المواد متوفرة حسب سجلات المخزن، الـ Work Fronts متاحة، الـ Rework قليل. ويُفضل وجود دليل تأكيدي: الإنتاجية تحسنت بعد تغيير الطاقم. لو أي فحص فشل، يكون السبب Disruption وليس Productivity، وقد تختلف المسؤولية.

required_points.text: Quantified planned vs achieved productivity from records
Excluded alternative causes (manpower, materials, access, rework)
Names data sources (daily reports, timesheets, quantity records)

acceptable_points.text: Shows a trend over time, not one day

advanced_points.text: Confirming evidence (improvement after corrective action)
Links cause to responsibility/entitlement

red_flags.text: Relies on site opinion ('everyone knew the crew was slow')
Argues: the activity is late, therefore productivity was low (circular)

question.en: What if the contractor disagrees and says the work fronts were released late?
question.ar: ماذا لو المقاول اعترض وقال إن الـ Work Fronts سُلمت متأخرة؟

expects: Check actual finish of predecessors per area
Area-by-area analysis
Possibly both causes apply

question.en: Blockwork is not on the critical path. Does the delay even matter?
question.ar: الطوب ليس على المسار الحرج. هل التأخير يهم أصلاً؟

expects: Consumes float
May become critical next update
Affects successor trades and cost

question.en: Next update it becomes critical. What changes in your report?
question.ar: في التحديث القادم أصبح حرجًا. ماذا يتغير في تقريرك؟

expects: Escalate as critical delay
Recovery options
Forecast completion impact

misconceptions: Low productivity is proven by the activity being late

scenario.en: Extract from the week 18 update of a residential building:
scenario.ar: مقتطف من تحديث الأسبوع 18 لمبنى سكني:

question.en: What is your first concern, and which activity would you investigate first and why?
question.ar: ما أول ما يقلقك، وأي نشاط ستبحث فيه أولاً ولماذا؟

thinking_objectives: Prioritising by criticality not by variance size

model_answer.en: Foundation first. Its progress gap (15%) is smaller than Columns (20%), but it is the only activity with negative float (−5 d), meaning it already pushes the completion or a milestone. Columns has the largest percentage gap but 10 days of float. However, Columns depends on Foundation, so its float will shrink as Foundation slips — I'd check whether its 20% lag is caused by Foundation or by its own resources. I'd investigate Foundation's remaining duration, resources, and cause of slippage, then confirm whether −5 d is driven by the project finish or a constraint. Excavation at 0 float and 100% complete is not a concern.
model_answer.ar_explanation: أبدأ بالـ Foundation. الفرق فيه (15%) أقل من الـ Columns (20%)، لكنه النشاط الوحيد بـ Float سالب (−5)، أي أنه يؤثر بالفعل على نهاية المشروع أو Milestone. الـ Columns عنده أكبر فرق لكن له 10 أيام Float، ومع ذلك يعتمد على الـ Foundation فسيقل الـ Float بتاعه. الأولوية بحسب الحرجية وليس بحجم الفرق.

required_points.text: Chooses Foundation first
Justifies by negative float/criticality, not by largest variance

advanced_points.text: Asks whether Column lag is caused by Foundation or own resources
Checks whether −5 is from project finish or a constraint

red_flags.text: Chooses Columns only because the % gap is largest

question.en: What report would you generate for the PM from this?
question.ar: ما التقرير الذي ستجهزه لمدير المشروع من هذا؟

expects: Critical/near-critical activities with variance and cause
Recovery actions with owners

misconceptions: The biggest % variance is always the biggest problem

scenario.en: The contractor's latest updated programme forecasts completion 25 days earlier than the approved baseline. Physical progress to date is slightly behind the baseline curve.
scenario.ar: آخر برنامج محدث للمقاول يتوقع الانتهاء قبل الـ Baseline المعتمد بـ 25 يومًا، بينما التقدم الفعلي حتى الآن متأخر قليلاً عن منحنى الـ Baseline.

question.en: Would you conclude the project is ahead of schedule? What would you check?
question.ar: هل ستستنتج أن المشروع متقدم على البرنامج؟ ماذا ستفحص؟

model_answer.en: No — an earlier forecast with progress behind the curve is a contradiction that must be explained. I would compare the update to the baseline and previous update: (1) remaining durations reduced without justification; (2) logic changes — relationships removed or changed from FS to SS, overlapping trades; (3) deleted or descoped activities; (4) constraints or lags changed; (5) calendars changed (e.g., to 7-day or longer shifts) — is that resourced and approved? (6) out-of-sequence progress handled with Progress Override; (7) productivity assumptions vs achieved productivity to date. If the changes are genuine (approved resequencing, extra shifts actually mobilised), the forecast may be credible; otherwise I would reject the programme for resubmission with a list of the unjustified changes.
model_answer.ar_explanation: لا. توقع انتهاء مبكر مع تقدم متأخر عن المنحنى تناقض يجب تفسيره. أقارن بالـ Baseline والتحديث السابق: تقليل Remaining Durations بدون مبرر، تغيير العلاقات (FS إلى SS)، حذف أنشطة، تغيير Constraints أو Lags، تغيير الـ Calendars، استخدام Progress Override، وافتراضات إنتاجية أعلى من المحقق. لو التغييرات حقيقية ومعتمدة، ممكن التوقع يكون منطقيًا؛ غير ذلك أرفض البرنامج وأطلب إعادة تقديم.

required_points.text: Does not conclude the project is ahead
Recognises contradiction between forecast and progress
Compares durations, logic and activities against baseline/previous update

advanced_points.text: Progress Override vs Retained Logic effect
Accepts the forecast if changes are genuine and resourced
Formal rejection/resubmission with list of issues

red_flags.text: Concludes the project is ahead based on forecast date

question.en: You find 14 FS relationships changed to SS with zero lag in finishing works. What is your assessment?
question.ar: وجدت 14 علاقة FS تحولت إلى SS بدون Lag في أعمال التشطيبات. ما تقييمك؟

expects: Possibly unrealistic overlap
Check physical feasibility/trade stacking
Require lags or justification

misconceptions: Forecast finish before baseline means the project is ahead
